helpCenterDesc: Find answers to frequently asked questions
faq1Q: How do I place an order?
faq1A: Browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You can pay using Telebirr or CBE.
faq2Q: How can I track my order?
faq2A: Go to the "Track Order" page and enter your Order ID. You can find your Order ID in your confirmation email.
faq3A: We offer nationwide delivery across Ethiopia. Delivery times vary by location but typically take 2-5 business days.
faq4Q: How do I become a merchant?
faq4A: Click on "Merchant Center" in the footer and fill out the application form. Our team will review your application within 24-48 hours.
faq5A: We accept returns within 7 days of delivery for most items in their original condition. Contact our support for assistance.

userGuideDesc: How to use ABAY Mart effectively
changeLanguageDesc: Abay Mart provides a seamless experience in both English and Amharic. You can switch between languages at any time to suit your preference.
changeLanguageSteps: On desktop, locate the English/አማርኛ toggle at the top-left of the page.
On mobile, tap the menu icon (three lines) to open the sidebar.
Select your preferred language from the toggle buttons in the sidebar.
The application will instantly refresh with your chosen language.
addToCartDesc: Adding items to your cart and placing an order is simple and secure.
addToCartSteps: Click on any product to view its details, price, and options.
Select your desired variants (size, color, etc.) and quantity.
Click 'Add to Cart' to keep shopping or 'Buy Now' to checkout immediately.
Review your cart and click 'Checkout' to provide your delivery information.
searchProductsDesc: Easily find what you are looking for using our powerful search and filters.
searchProductsSteps: Type product names or keywords into the main search bar at the top.
Browse collections by clicking on categories in the sidebar or menu.
Use filters to narrow down products by price or availability.
Ask our AI Assistant if you need personalized recommendations!
trackOrderDesc: Stay updated on your order's journey from our store to your home.
trackOrderSteps: Copy the Order ID provided after you complete a purchase.
Go to the 'Track Order' page from the menu or footer.
Enter your Order ID in the field and click 'Track'.
See your status move from Processing to Shipped and finally Delivered.
becomeMerchantDesc: Grow your business by selling on Ethiopia's premium marketplace.
becomeMerchantSteps: Click on 'Become a Verified Seller' in the top bar or footer.
Sign in to your account if you haven't already.
Fill in your store name, TIN number, and business details in the form.
Upload your business registration and submit for our team's review.
promotionsDesc: Discover our latest deals, limited-time offers, and exclusive discounts across all our categories across Ethiopia.
